title: Errorpack
description: a resourcepack for the ERROR mod i am currently making
body:
this is a small resourcepack that makes some of the textures glitched and changes ui, mobs, gui, hud and more
its relatively small and a joke, nothing is actually broken in any way/shape of form
do not use it for a malicious intent, this resource pack is intended to be used as a harmless joke or just a normal texture pack 
(this resourcepack is for a mod i am making called ERRORmod)
